name: AD — KRBTGT Account Password Reset (Golden Ticket Prep / Remediation)
description:
Attacker objective
A KRBTGT password reset is either Golden-Ticket remediation or attacker manipulation of the domain's Kerberos trust — a Tier-0 event that must be verified.

Attack logic
The KRBTGT account is not reset in normal operation. Any reset is a Tier-0 change to the domain's Kerberos master key.

Why this detection works
Password-reset events (4724/4723) targeting the krbtgt account are a zero-baseline tripwire.

False positives
A deliberate, scheduled KRBTGT rotation.

Tuning
Correlate with planned rotation activity and change control.

Required telemetry
Windows Security 4724/4723 (TargetUserName=krbtgt, SubjectUserName).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Confirm whether this is a planned rotation.
2. If not, investigate as potential Golden-Ticket activity and treat the domain as compromised until cleared.
